title: Towards Low-Resource Harmful Meme Detection with LMM Agents

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the model's zero-shot and few-shot classification performance (Accuracy and Macro-F1) on the MAMI (Multimedia Automatic Misogyny Identification) dataset, which consists of memes predominantly derogatory towards women.
Evaluating the model's ability to detect harmful and hateful multimodal content using the Facebook Hateful Memes (FHM) challenge dataset.
Qualitative error analysis of misclassified test samples to identify inherent model biases, specifically revealing the model's tendency to underestimate the negative impact of religious-themed memes.
